title: Grothendieck group of finite projectives
statement: For a commutative ring $S$, $K_0(S)$ is the abelian group generated by symbols $[Q]$, one for each isomorphism class of finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] $S$-modules $Q$, modulo the relations $[Q']+[Q'']=[Q'\oplus Q'']$ for all such $Q',Q''$.
